title: C vs spec: DAO delegation gate keyed by origin address, not the pinned pubkey (spec 8.6 mandates pubkey-keyed replay)
description: Surfaced while scoping t3b7 (route-state vector consumers bypass the delegation gate). The C ztest's gate lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate registers delegations keyed by ORIGIN ADDRESS (test/vectors/rpl_route_state.json delegations array is address-keyed accordingly), but spec/05-routing.md 8.6 says 'Replay state is keyed by the pinned 32-octet public key, not by the full IPv6 address'. The Rust (PrefixDelegations.authorizes) and Python (origin_validator + pinned key + Schnorr48) gates are pubkey-keyed. Decide with Mark whether the C contract (address-keyed delegation authorization) is a spec divergence needing a C fix, or an accepted address->pubkey binding difference — the answer determines t3b7's fix shape (whether the oracle needs pubkey bindings or address bindings).
